detail.longDescription: In another life, I ran social for a number of small companies. And if I had a nickel for every time someone said, "Social's easy. Just do [insert suggestion that's definitely been done before]," I'd have long been retired. Building a social media strategy and executing it is anything but easy. That's why people turn to social media management giants like Hootsuite to streamline their efforts. It allows you to control your full social media presence across multiple platforms in one place.
